name: Trophy and Achievement Roadmap
summary: A completion-focused route for tracking trophies separately from 100% game completion and protecting potentially missable progress.
description: Launch-era trophy guides list 55 offline trophies: one Platinum, two Gold, six Silver, and 46 Bronze. Trophy completion and the in-game 100% checklist are different goals. The trophy roadmap flags a potentially missable early meditation; make a manual save and consult the live roadmap before leaving Chapter 1 if you want a clean one-playthrough run.

steps.title: Decide whether to pursue one playthrough
steps.content: If trophy completion matters, review the current trophy roadmap before beginning. Keep a manual save around chapter transitions and complete optional activities when they appear.
steps.tip: The game’s own checklist is not the same as the trophy list.

steps.title: Protect early optional activities
steps.content: The published roadmap warns that an early meditation may be missable. Do the activity when first available, then verify its trophy pop or tracker entry.
steps.tip: The exact missable status can change with patches; check the current roadmap.

steps.title: Complete the story and clean up in free roam
steps.content: Use post-story free roam to finish open-world trophies and checklist categories. Track story, activities, collectibles, and challenges independently.
steps.tip: Launch guides report no mission replay, so preserve manual saves if you want to revisit story-specific content.

steps.title: Use the trophy list for final verification
steps.content: Compare each platform trophy/achievement against the roadmap and confirm the final unlock on your console profile.
steps.tip: Do not rely only on the wiki tracker; it is stored locally in your browser.

requirements: Review the current trophy roadmap before leaving Chapter 1 if pursuing a one-playthrough run.
Keep a manual save at major story transitions.
commonMistakes: Assuming 100% checklist completion automatically awards every trophy.
Leaving an early optional activity without checking the missable warning.
